new.name: FORMULATES_TESTABLE_EXPLANATION_FOR_ANOMALY
new.definition: The reasoning identifies an observed anomaly, inconsistency, or unexpected state and proposes a specific explanatory hypothesis about its cause that can be checked against further evidence.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The agent text stating the anomaly and proposing an explanatory hypothesis.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning identifies a specific anomaly, inconsistency, or unexpected observed state.
The reasoning proposes a causal or structural explanation for that state rather than merely restating it.
The proposed explanation is framed so that additional evidence could confirm or refute it.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning only lists observations or task requirements without identifying an anomaly.
The reasoning states a conclusion without proposing an explanatory hypothesis for an anomaly.

new.name: INTERPRETS_RAW_REPRESENTATION_AS_STRUCTURED_DATA
new.definition: The reasoning decodes raw byte-level or character-level content in the observation into structured fields, records, or values according to an inferred format.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning that decodes the raw observation into structured information.

parameters.name: observation
parameters.description: The observation containing raw or low-level representation of the artifact.

assertion_conditions: The observation contains raw byte-level, character-level, or otherwise low-level representation of the artifact.
The reasoning identifies structural boundaries, field types, record layouts, or encoded values within that representation.
The reasoning explicitly maps the raw content to higher-level structured data rather than merely repeating it.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning only comments on file size, metadata, or the existence of the artifact without decoding its raw content.
The observation does not contain raw or low-level representation.
The reasoning restates raw bytes without assigning them structural or semantic meaning.

new.name: IMPLEMENTS_DERIVED_MODEL_AS_REUSABLE_TOOL
new.definition: The action creates an executable script or tool whose logic operationalizes a structural model or procedure inferred from prior observations, so the model can be applied systematically.

parameters.name: action
parameters.description: The action creating the executable tool or script that implements the derived model.

assertion_conditions: The action creates an executable script, tool, or program rather than performing a one-off manual operation.
The content of the created artifact encodes parsing, decoding, or processing rules inferred from prior observations.
The created artifact is intended to apply those rules systematically to the target data.
exclusion_conditions: The action performs an ad hoc inspection or direct manipulation without creating a reusable tool.
The created artifact contains static output rather than logic implementing an inferred model.
The created script is unrelated to the structural model inferred from observations.

new.name: APPLIES_DERIVED_MODEL_TO_EXTRACT_RECORDS
new.definition: An action executes a procedure that implements a structural model inferred from prior observations against a raw artifact, and the resulting observation reports structured records extracted according to that model.

parameters.name: extraction_action
parameters.description: The action running the derived extraction procedure.

parameters.name: model_reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning that states the inferred structural model or parsing rules.

parameters.name: extraction_result
parameters.description: The observation reporting the structured records produced by the procedure.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning specifies a structural model or parsing rules inferred from earlier evidence.
The action executes a procedure that implements those rules on the artifact.
The observation reports extracted structured records consistent with the stated model.
exclusion_conditions: The action performs ad hoc inspection not based on an inferred model.
The observation does not report structured records resulting from the procedure.
No reasoning establishes the model being applied.

new.name: VALIDATES_GENERATED_ARTIFACT_WITH_INDEPENDENT_CHECK
new.definition: An action independently re-reads or recomputes properties of a generated artifact using separate checks, and the observation confirms whether those properties match expected values.

parameters.name: validation_action
parameters.description: The action that independently checks the generated artifact or recomputes its values.

parameters.name: validation_result
parameters.description: The observation reporting whether the checked properties match expectations.

assertion_conditions: The action targets a previously generated artifact or values derived from it.
The action performs an independent read-back, recomputation, or cross-check rather than merely creating the artifact.
The observation reports agreement or disagreement with expected values or invariants.
exclusion_conditions: The action only creates or writes the artifact without checking it.
The check is not independent because it simply repeats the generating operation.
The observation does not report any match or mismatch against expected values.

new.name: ASSESSES_COMPLETENESS_OF_RECOVERY
new.definition: The reasoning evaluates the extent to which all recoverable information has been extracted, justifying a bound on the result by accounting for available and unavailable data regions.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning that evaluates the completeness and limits of the recovery.

assertion_conditions: The reasoning accounts for the data regions that were recovered and those that are missing or unavailable.
The reasoning explains why no further recoverable information remains within the available artifact.
The reasoning concludes a justified bound on the maximum possible recovery.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning only reports the final output without evaluating completeness.
The reasoning claims completeness without evidence accounting for unavailable or unexamined data.

uncertain.name: REVISES_PRIOR_INTERPRETATION_IN_LIGHT_OF_NEW_EVIDENCE
uncertain.definition: The reasoning explicitly corrects or replaces an earlier interpretation because new observation contradicts or clarifies it, and adopts a revised account supported by the new evidence.

parameters.name: reasoning
parameters.description: The reasoning that acknowledges the earlier interpretation and adopts the revised one.

parameters.name: observation
parameters.description: The new observation that conflicts with or clarifies the earlier interpretation.

assertion_conditions: An earlier interpretation, expectation, or puzzle is identifiable in the reasoning.
The new observation conflicts with, clarifies, or resolves that earlier interpretation.
The reasoning explicitly acknowledges the change and adopts a revised account consistent with the new observation.
exclusion_conditions: The reasoning simply adds a new conclusion without correcting or replacing an earlier interpretation.
No prior interpretation or expectation is identifiable.
The reasoning ignores the conflicting evidence.
